versions.name: Pierre Hoge Scout Camp
versions.summary: A wilderness conservation camp of the Daniel Webster Council near Walpole in western New Hampshire, with wooded acreage, undeveloped primitive campsites, and a conservation pond used for weekend and troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Daniel Webster Council (Scouting America New Hampshire) camp-properties page, which lists Pierre Hoge Scout Camp in Walpole as a current council property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (US Census returned no match for the street-only address); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active status verified against the council's own camp-properties listing; classified conservatively as a primitive weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
